premises.text: Periodic audits, noisy scanners, and permissive firewalls leave a persistent gap between fast development workflows and application security
premises.evidence_span: security audits cannot be performed each time your code is changed

premises.text: Runtime in-app monitoring of critical functions blocks attacks by logic blueprints rather than patterns, reducing false positives
premises.evidence_span: Screen is a security solution that protects your application at runtime

premises.text: Installs like a normal dependency and presents debugger-like attack detail, user-protection signals, and backtraces in a simple developer dashboard
premises.evidence_span: installing screen is not different from installing any other dependency in your application

premises.text: Pricing starts at $99/month and scales by hosts, with support for Python, Rails, and Node.js
premises.evidence_span: our pricing starts at only $99 per month and scales as you grow with the number of hosts

value.text: Developers can protect applications simply without the traditional security-tool gap

causal_links.evidence_span: enable all developers to protect their application

notes: Audit/scanner/firewall failure modes folded as one security-gap problem (v1.5.1 §4.1.6). Logic-based blocking, SQLi blueprint, account-takeover signals, and dashboard detail folded as cascade of the runtime product (§4.1.7). Attack-count and beta-user traction excluded.
